headline: Check Point confirms PHP2Shell zero-day gives root; N-central zero-day hits patched servers; SCKit worm spreads among MSPs

bullets.text: New: Check Point now warns that the PHP2Shell zero-day (CVE-2026-123039, 5 outlets) is exploited for root access on gateways; attackers deploy a TSGA backdoor and wipe ESXi files. No fixed release version is on the board.

New: law enforcement disrupted Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC infrastructure; Have I Been Pwned added 179,745 CastleRAT accounts. US also seized North Korean infrastructure and $1.2B stolen from Binance.
N-central (PoC, 6 outlets): the N-able '4EverAble2Shell' zero-day was exploited hours after a PoC; 21 servers infected, 19 on Hotfix 2, so patched servers are not safe. No CVE or fix is on the board.
MSPs (8 outlets): worm-like SCKit malware spreads through ScreenConnect support sessions, nearly 50 organizations report breaches, and ConnectWise has disabled third-party extensions.

Still active: SignDrop Windows CLFS zero-day gives SYSTEM (no fix on board); 4,800 GitHub accounts hijacked for cloud credentials; Apache httpd HTTP/2 RCE CVE-2026-119618 patched; Xen Orchestra flaws exploited; Red Hat Quay flaw.

KEV due today (11-13): Barracuda CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560. Due 11-24: Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320, Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Chromium CVE-2026-125350. SITCON 3; last 7 days run 1.09x the 90-day average.

actions: Check Point: check its advisory for a CVE-2026-123039 fix and apply it, limit gateway management to trusted networks, and hunt for TSGA backdoor indicators.
Back up ESXi hosts offline and check Check Point gateways for signs of root compromise before and after patching.
N-central: treat servers as exposed even on Hotfix 2; take consoles off the internet and hunt for new admin accounts and unexpected agent commands.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and extensions, confirm third-party extensions are disabled, and hunt for SCKit spreading from support sessions.
Check hosts for Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC infections and rotate credentials on any machine that had them.
Patch Barracuda ESG today (KEV deadline 11-13) and Apache httpd for CVE-2026-119618; review GitHub sign-ins, PATs and Actions secrets.
